First, convert 31 weeks and 4 days to days:  
31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days  
217 + 4 = 221 days before 1599-12-18.

Subtract 221 days from 1599-12-18:  
December has 31 days, so 18 days back from Dec 18 is Dec 1 (17 days earlier) → 221 - 17 = 204 days left.  
November 1599 has 30 days, October 31, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (1599 not leap year), January 31.  

Count backward:  
From Dec 1:  
Nov: 30 days → 204 - 30 = 174 left  
Oct: 31 → 174 - 31 = 143  
Sep: 30 → 143 - 30 = 113  
Aug: 31 → 113 - 31 = 82  
Jul: 31 → 82 - 31 = 51  
Jun: 30 → 51 - 30 = 21  
May: 31 → 21 - 31 = -10 → means we go into May 10 days before the end of May.  
May has 31 days, so May 31 - 10 days = May 21.

Thus, date is 1599-05-21.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-05-21
